principles.name: Modular Monolith-first
principles.rule: Keep one operationally simple backend deployment with explicit domain module boundaries for the Pilot.

principles.name: Relational source of truth
principles.rule: Transactional business records live in a relational database; search and analytics are rebuildable projections.

principles.name: Public read separate from Admin command
principles.rule: Public APIs return Published data only; every privileged write is authenticated, authorized, validated and audited.

principles.name: External failure isolation
principles.rule: Social, map, message and analytics failure cannot remove available core Place information or actions.

principles.name: Link-only media
principles.rule: Store canonical URL, permitted metadata and attribution; do not download or re-host social video.

principles.name: Consent-aware measurement
principles.rule: Separate essential and optional analytics; optional events require consent and do not block user actions.

principles.name: Server-enforced trust
principles.rule: Authorization, record rules, publish gates, sponsored disclosure and audit are enforced on the server.

principles.name: Evidence before scale
principles.rule: Add or split infrastructure only when measured performance, reliability or ownership evidence supports it.

components.name: Edge & Delivery
components.responsibility: TLS, routing, static assets, caching, basic rate limiting and request IDs

components.name: Guest Web
components.responsibility: Feed, Search, Place, Consent and Map/Call/Message handoff

components.name: Admin Web
components.responsibility: Ten modules, 55 views, operational workflow, evidence and role-aware controls

components.name: Public API
components.responsibility: Published-only Feed, Search and Place queries

components.name: Admin API
components.responsibility: Commands and controlled queries for all Admin domains

components.name: Domain Modules
components.responsibility: Business rules, state transitions, publish gates, eligibility, deduplication and calculations

components.name: Primary Database
components.responsibility: System of record, constraints, transactions, version fields and outbox

components.name: Search Projection
components.responsibility: Rebuildable Published Place search and filter index

components.name: Job Queue & Worker
components.responsibility: Source checks, freshness, scheduled campaigns, projections, notification and aggregates

components.name: Analytics Ingest & Aggregate
components.responsibility: Consent validation, event deduplication, Decision Intent and privacy-safe aggregates

components.name: Integration Adapters
components.responsibility: Social metadata/embed, map, deep links, notification and future payment adapters

components.name: Object & Evidence Storage
components.responsibility: Approved Place images, posters, evidence and generated exports

components.name: Identity & Session
components.responsibility: Admin sign-in, sessions, roles and privileged-step verification

components.name: Observability & Recovery
components.responsibility: Logs, metrics, traces, alerts, backup verification and restore evidence
